scope.boundary: All application source files in these roots are enumerated. JS functions/tables are parsed; Rust/Python/C++ candidates also require semantic review. Textual equality is a candidate, not proof of equivalent contracts.

scalar_width_tables.disposition: Independent symbolic-cost reconstruction oracle; deliberately does not import production width rules.

TensorFlow TensorProto protobuf field numbers (float_val=5, double_val=6, int_val=7, int64_val=10, bool_val=11, half_val=13, uint32_val=16, uint64_val=17), not scalar bit widths or storage arithmetic. Numeric decoding uses existing scalar-numeric and ONNX byte visitors; compared to tf.make_ndarray in check-tensorflow-source-numerics.py.

native_scalar_tables.disposition: Synthetic sensitivity-input amplitudes (30, 0.3, 1000), not dtype storage widths or measured data.

disposition.reason: Independent conformance implementations of direct integer-to-binary32 conversion. Production uses scalar-numeric.js; external Fraction oracle also verifies every production boundary.
Symbolic shape-cost conformance reconstructs native spatial attributes independently from the production formula builder.
Independent operator-conformance readers retain separate native attribute validation.
One production Number/BigInt-to-float32 adapter is shared; independent conformance paths retain their own integer-rounding implementation.
ChatGPT and Claude sandbox widgets have isolated delivery/bootstrap contracts. These format labels only; neither computes artifact bytes or IR metrics.
Independent conformance multiplication for linear models and one-hot encoding; production safe-count products use tensor-size.js.
Independent vocabulary conformance checks preserve typed key equality; production vocabulary counts have one owner in onnx-static-value-evidence.js.
Independent conformance shape products; production shape products are centralized and checked against separate integer/broadcast oracles.
Inspector and report independently compare named observed count dictionaries; neither computes the underlying counts.
